scope: The section blocks a landing page is assembled from. Page sections ONLY — not page formats (what kind of page it is), not email modules, not creative formats. Each of those is its own bank; the map is components/naming/FORMATS.md in ai-workspace.
note: Built 2026-09-11 because nothing listed these and choosing one meant opening 82 files. Every `name` and `what` is DRAFT — written by reading the markup, never approved. Correct any that read wrong; nothing here is Damon's word until it is signed. `id`, `family`, `origin` and `variables` are mechanical: read straight off the files and safe to trust. Conforms to the bank standard in components/naming/FORMATS.md.

blocks.name: Before/after slider
blocks.what: Swiper carousel of before/after images with an optional caption under each slide; for a scrollable set of transformation photos.

blocks.name: Before/after review cards
blocks.what: Carousel of before/after cards each with a star rating, title, review body and author; transformation testimonials as a carousel.

blocks.name: Accordion benefits panel
blocks.what: Heading and subheading beside a square feature image and a four-item accordion of benefit titles and bodies, ending in a CTA.

blocks.name: Benefit grid with review
blocks.what: Product image beside a 2x2 grid of four icon benefits and a single review-quote card; compact benefits plus social proof.

blocks.name: Benefit rows with stats
blocks.what: Two alternating image/text rows, each with a title, body, a highlighted stat box and a star-rated review snippet.

blocks.name: Collage banner with steps
blocks.what: Brand-colour announcement bar, a heading, a ten-image photo collage, then two numbered step rows.

blocks.name: Numbered benefit rows
blocks.what: A brand-colour heading bar then three alternating image/text rows, each numbered and titled.

blocks.name: Steps with press CTA
blocks.what: Heading, banner image, two detailed steps each with three labelled bullets, then a CTA panel with an As Seen On press strip.

blocks.name: Rating and bullets CTA
blocks.what: Image beside a rating line, heading, subheading, three bullets and a CTA with a guarantee line; a closing conversion block.

blocks.name: Warehouse-sale offer card
blocks.what: A dashed-border card with an overhanging sale badge, product image, heading and CTA; a sale-styled closing offer.

blocks.name: Us vs them cards
blocks.what: Two comparison cards sharing the same list — a grey one with crosses, a brand one with checks — plus a CTA.

blocks.name: Feature comparison table
blocks.what: A row-by-row table comparing the brand against competitors across up to eight features, plus a guarantee banner.

blocks.name: Multi-competitor cost table
blocks.what: A labelled table stacking the brand against two named alternatives across up to eight rows, ending in cost.

blocks.name: Sticky mobile bottom bar
blocks.what: A fixed bottom bar on mobile with a CTA and guarantee line that fades in on scroll and hides near the page bottom.

blocks.name: Autoplay demo video
blocks.what: A muted, looping, autoplaying demo video with heading, subheading and caption, falling back to a poster frame when motion is restricted.

blocks.name: Founder's letter
blocks.what: A single-column letter with an optional mid-letter pullquote, closing on a portrait and signature, with the guarantee in the founder's own words.

blocks.name: Scrolling text ribbon
blocks.what: A continuously scrolling coloured band repeating one line, so the promise is scrolled through rather than past.

blocks.name: Pre-sell price card
blocks.what: Pricing tiers, per-unit maths, what is included and the guarantee shown before the click, so the offer page confirms rather than surprises.

blocks.name: Real review grid
blocks.what: A grid of real reviews written into front matter by a refresh script, photo-carrying ones surfaced first.

blocks.name: Live Junip review wall
blocks.what: Junip's live verified-purchase widget under a heading, replacing hand-written testimonials with reviews pulled at load.

blocks.name: FAQ with sidebar CTA
blocks.what: A sticky sidebar with product image and CTA beside a nine-question accordion; stacked on mobile.

blocks.name: Accordion FAQ
blocks.what: Overline, heading and a seven-question accordion with the first item open, ending in a CTA.

blocks.name: Feature rows with testimonial
blocks.what: Two alternating image/text rows, each pairing a feature with a bordered testimonial quote card.

blocks.name: Bullets with cert strip

blocks.name: Icon list with photo

blocks.name: Product image feature grid

blocks.name: Radial feature diagram

blocks.name: Specs with bonus gifts

blocks.name: Icon feature card grid

blocks.name: Simple legal footer
